# StreamApp

A streaming app: a Kafka topic in, an Iceberg table out.

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec.engine` | string | No | `spark` |  | `spark` |
| `spec.ownerGroup` | string (nullable) | No |  | The group whose members may see and stop the stream; absent means administrators only. | min 1, max 64; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` |
| `spec.restartPolicy` | string | No | `always` |  | `always`, `on-failure` |
| `spec.runAs` | string (nullable) | No |  | The `ServicePrincipal` the job runs as (convention: `pipeline-<ownerGroup>`). | min 1, max 40; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `spec.sink` | object | Yes |  |  |  |
| `spec.sink.catalog` | string | Yes |  | Catalog the sink table lives in; it must let `runAs` write. | min 1, max 63; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `spec.sink.checkpointPrefix` | string (nullable) | No |  | S3 prefix for the checkpoint; absent means `checkpoints/<namespace>/<name>`. | min 1, max 512; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_./-]*$` |
| `spec.sink.mergeKeys` | array of string | No |  | Columns of `MERGE … ON`; 1 to 8, each one an existing column. | min 0, max 8 |
| `spec.sink.mode` | string | No | `merge` |  | `merge`, `append` |
| `spec.sink.table` | string | Yes |  | `schema.table`. | min 3, max 128; pattern `^[a-z0-9_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$` |
| `spec.source` | object | Yes |  |  |  |
| `spec.source.connectionRef` | string | Yes |  | Name of the `Connection` (`type: kafka`) whose `config.bootstrapServers` the job reads. | min 1, max 63; pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$` |
| `spec.source.format` | string | No | `json` |  | `json` |
| `spec.source.topic` | string | Yes |  |  | min 1, max 249; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` |
| `spec.stopped` | boolean | No | `false` | `true` stops the job and deletes its SparkApplication; the checkpoint is kept, so `stopped: false` resumes from it. The one verb Nova's page needs. |  |

## Validation rules

- a stream needs a topic of 1 to 249 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or dash
- sink.table is schema.table, lower-case letters, digits and underscores
- sink.mode merge needs mergeKeys; append forbids them
